name: Rokka Okada
bio:
Born on January 8, 2014.

She has appeared in films such as "And Then the Baton Was Passed" (2021), dramas such as "My Favorite Flower" (2023) and "Let Lonely Death Fall" (2024), and has also appeared in stage productions such as "Touken Ranbu" and "Togen Anki".

credits.title: Inu-Oh
credits.overview: A cursed dancer and a blind musician — both ostracized by society — become business partners and inseparable friends as their larger-than-life concerts propel them to stardom in 14th century Japan.
